requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.
notes: Java21 and Pyserini for original Lucene tokenization
Up to40-65GB RAM for largest corpora
Place the BEIR webis-touche2020 corpus under datasets/beir/webis-touche2020 in the checkout; the pinned evaluator otherwise downloads the archive at run time, which seed checks do not do.

commands.notes: Source-composed invocation of documented evaluator CLI and exclusion environment, selecting exactly this dataset. Uses original BM25 seed; no LLM API needed. Not executed against downloaded data.

notes: Source-inspected adapter; external benchmark corpora have not been downloaded or evaluated.
Environment must be set BEFORE module import; excludes all other27 documented public datasets.
Candidate exports BM25, Corpus, tokenize and LuceneTokenizer. Lucene tokenizer requires Java21/Pyserini.
One dataset worker reduces concurrency but large corpora still need substantial RAM; TREC DL indexes8.84million passages and upstream estimates40-65GB RAM per large corpus.
Paper compares BM25 and QL-Dir seeds; current public tree retains BM25 evaluator and archived QL outputs.
Direct evaluation requires no LLM. Current release BM25 evaluator selected; archived QL results do not supply a matching QL evaluator.

suite.unsupported_reason: Fitness requires the BEIR data and training pipeline, which are not redistributed with the suite.

limitations: Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
